name: We Laugh Pohanghang 2025

venue.name: [장량국민체육센터 (Jangnyang Sports Center)](https://www.phsisul.org/sisul_11/main.do)
venue.address: 경상북도 포항시 북구 장량로 56 (56, Jangnyang-ro, Buk-gu, Pohang-si, Gyeongsangbuk-do)

information: ## 포항에서 열리는 첫 WCA 대회! WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WeLaughPohanghang2025#63182-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WeLaughPohanghang2025#63181-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ ## First WCA competition in Pohang City! If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WeLaughPohanghang2025#63182-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WeLaughPohanghang2025#63181-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request. Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.
